draft.heroMessage: Follow Your Path in Grand Rapids Real Estate
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome! I'm Scott A Jacobs, your trusted Grand Rapids REALTOR®—here to serve your unique real estate needs with dedication and a practical, expert approach.
draft.aboutParagraph: With a strong corporate business background and a talent for negotiation, I take pride in supporting clients through every stage of their real estate journey. Whether you’re looking for your dream home, exploring investment opportunities, or preparing to sell, I’ll bring market insight, tenacity, and personal attention to every step of the process. Let’s make your goals a reality—with honesty, transparency, and a commitment to serving your best interests.
draft.conciergeLine: Ready to talk real estate? Let’s grab coffee or schedule a call—your next step starts here.
draft.contactLine: Reach out at 616-481-2122 or scottaj0204@gmail.com to start your journey.
draft.tone: Approachable, practical, and service-oriented with a focus on guidance and integrity.

websiteDesign.heroSubtitle: Whether it's finding your dream home or investment properties, I can help bring together the design, community, and lifestyle you're searching for. Nature lovers and wildlife enthusiasts: the possibilities are endless! Are you looking for a peaceful destination without the city lights and traffic noise? This is where you can see all the stars and hear the surrounding sounds of nature.

This Central Michigan Lower Peninsula property features three homes on one of the largest tracts of land available for sale in Michigan. ''Hopkins Trophy Whitetail Ranch” is currently an active licensed deer ranch open to year-around hunting with five miles of 10' fencing and numerous deluxe deer blinds for you and your guests. And if desired, the property can be converted into a free-range private hunting and fishing camp for exclusive use for friends and family.

The terrain consists mostly of wooded high ground, with some open fields, food plots and a few sections of deep cover.
